description: navigator.connection. Consumed by patch 0088, which serves the pre-rounding state so Chromium's own quantisation applies: NetworkStateNotifier rounds rtt to a multiple of 50 ms and downlink to 0.05 Mbps after a host-salted 0.90..1.10 multiplier. Every option sits inside the effective-connection-type band its own rtt implies, using the exact thresholds in net/nqe/network_quality_estimator_params.h (4g < 272 ms, 3g 272..1419, 2g 1420..2009, slow-2g >= 2010), so the emitter's clamp never has to fire.
